Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

LevelRole.description: The role of a terminal level.

LevelSpec.description: One level of a multi-level terminal.

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

designation.description: The designation, unique within the strip.

seq.description: The drawn and mounting order; default one more than the highest in the strip.

Uuid.description: A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

description:
`terminal.add`: terminals of a strip; a terminal is a device with the terminal aspect (doc 03 §11).

For each terminal in order: a device `{tag: {letter: the strip's letter, counter: seq}, kind:
terminal, structure: the strip's structure, function_text, terminal: {strip, seq, designation, levels,
rail_bonded}}` and its main function `{def: fndef}`. Rejected: the strip is not a device with the strip
aspect; a designation already used in the strip or twice in the list; a sequence number already used.
Outcome: the first new terminal device.
title: terminal.add
